Definition: of uncertain (perhaps foreign) origin; byssos, i.e. bleached linen (the cloth or a garment of it):--(fine) linen (cloth).
BiblicalUsage: Sindon is fine linen, the clean cloth, and it wraps the body of Jesus in death. Joseph took Him down and wrapped Him in linen, the young man in the garden fled leaving his linen cloth behind, and Joseph of Arimathea bought fine linen and laid the body in a tomb hewn out of rock.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the linen that wrapped Jesus is the cloth of honour. His friends gave Him the best they had for His burial, and I hold that love gives its best even when there is nothing left to gain.
